# SteadyGantt

> SteadyGantt is a Gantt chart app for Jira Cloud with safe rescheduling: it is read-only until the user confirms a field-level diff, every sync has one-click undo, and all drafts and view state autosave. Built on Atlassian Forge ("Runs on Atlassian" — data never leaves Atlassian's infrastructure; no external servers, no trackers). Free for teams of 10 or fewer. Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/55985132

## Product
- [Product page](https://leo-liu-522.github.io/steadygantt/index.html): what SteadyGantt does and the safety model
- [Live demo](https://leo-liu-522.github.io/steadygantt/demo/): the full app running in the browser on sample data — drag, diff, sync, undo, no install
- [Atlassian Marketplace listing](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/55985132): install for Jira Cloud
